supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:57, WS-MLOPEZ-01 recorded a network logon for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01; the logon ID matches the subsequent PowerShell process.
At 13:41:49, PowerShell ran as omar.haddad with the command `-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1`, matching the documented IT patching workflow.
The PowerShell process launched wusa to install a Windows 11 update package quietly, while the proxy recorded a 38.8 MB Windows Update download.
The PowerShell process and its wusa child both exited shortly afterward.

The supplied records do not include the contents or output of Deploy-Patches.ps1, or independently establish who personally initiated the remote action.
